milestones.title: Skeleton imports
milestones.goal: Every module under src/main/org/apache/commons/fileupload/** imports cleanly with signatures intact (bodies may still be `pass`). build_check passes.

milestones.title: Leaf exceptions & simple value types
milestones.goal: Implement FileUploadException (cause, static factories FileUploadException0/1, printStackTrace0/1), InvalidFileNameException (NUL-byte name carrier), FileCountLimitExceededException (limit), and util/mime/ParseException, matching Java attribute/behavior exactly.

milestones.title: Core interfaces/ABC contracts
milestones.goal: Implement the ABC-shaped contracts with no behavior beyond method presence/state: RequestContext, UploadContext, FileItemHeaders, FileItemHeadersSupport, ProgressListener, FileItemFactory, FileItem, FileItemStream, FileItemIterator, util/Closeable.

milestones.title: Utility/codec leaves
milestones.goal: Implement util/Streams, util/mime/Base64Decoder, util/mime/QuotedPrintableDecoder, util/mime/MimeUtility, util/FileItemHeadersImpl, util/LimitedInputStream, reproducing exact decode output and error cases (IOException/ParseException-equivalents) for malformed input.

milestones.title: Parsing core
milestones.goal: Implement ParameterParser (parse0..3 overloads, isLowerCaseNames/setLowerCaseNames, private token scanner) and MultipartStream (boundary detection, boundaryTable, readByte/readBoundary/setBoundary, readHeaders with HEADER_PART_SIZE_MAX enforcement, ProgressNotifier, ItemInputStream read0/read1/close0/close1/skip/available, MalformedStreamException, IllegalBoundaryException), reproducing identical boundary/header detection and byte-for-byte stream content.

milestones.title: FileItem implementations
milestones.goal: Implement disk/DiskFileItem (constructor state, getContentType, getCharSet, getName w/ NUL-check via Streams.checkFileName, getFieldName/setFieldName, isFormField/setFormField, getTempFile, getHeaders/setHeaders, getDefaultCharset/setDefaultCharset, getUniqueId), disk/DiskFileItemFactory (DEFAULT_SIZE_THRESHOLD, sizeThreshold/repository/defaultCharset accessors, DiskFileItemFactory1), and the deprecated thin subclasses DefaultFileItem/DefaultFileItemFactory.

milestones.title: Top-level API & container adapters
milestones.goal: Implement FileUploadBase (constants, sizeMax/fileSizeMax/fileCountMax/headerEncoding/listener state+accessors, isMultipartContent, header-parsing helpers getBoundary/getFileName0-2/getFieldName0-2/createItem/getParsedHeaders/parseHeaders/parseHeaderLine/parseEndOfLine/getHeader/newFileItemHeaders/getContentLength, and nested exception types FileUploadIOException/IOFileUploadException/SizeException/InvalidContentTypeException/UnknownSizeException/SizeLimitExceededException/FileSizeLimitExceededException plus the data-holding FileItemStreamImpl), FileUpload (fileItemFactory field/accessors, constructor), servlet/ServletRequestContext, and portlet/PortletFileUpload (constructor + PortletFileUpload1).

milestones.title: Golden parity pass
milestones.goal: Full conformance: every class in src/main/org/apache/commons/fileupload/** has no pass/.../TODO/NotImplementedError bodies remaining; all classes reproduce the Java contract exactly, and the entire own-test suite plus every prior milestone's selectors pass together.
